name: error
description: This event is fired when posting stats fails, the webhook cannot start, or Top.gg sends a vote that cannot be used

name: posted
description: This event is fired when your bot's stats were posted to Top.gg

name: voteReminder
description: This event is fired when a user who voted can vote again (needs the reminders option); the vote functions describe their last vote

name: voted
description: This event is fired once for each vote (or test vote) Top.gg delivers to your webhook
